Enables or disables one exact direct Fabric Interconnect physical port, including a breakout child. Prerequisites: select an Intersight endpoint target whose runtime user can read organizations and fabric port operations and can update the matched port operation. The workflow escapes OData string inputs, requires exactly one organization and one port match, fixes FexId at 0 to exclude FEX and IOM host ports, and verifies that the expanded network element has SwitchType FabricInterconnect before sending the update. A successful run confirms that Cisco Intersight accepted the PATCH request; it does not poll or verify device-side application of the new administrative state.
